40017873.author: पदार्थः
40017873.content: भ्रातृवत्सले affectionate brother, लक्ष्मणे by Lakshmana, रामम् Rama आश्वासमाने comforting, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, गुल्मान् troops, स्वस्थाने to their respective places, निक्षिप्य assigning, तत्र there, आगच्छत् came

40017873.author: Translation
40017873.content: As Lakshmana was comforting his affectionate brother, Vibheeshana came to Rama assigning the troops to reach their respective places.

40017874.author: पदार्थः
40017874.content: नानाप्रहरणैः different kinds of weapons, नीलाञ्जनचयाकारैः dark in colour like collyrium, यूथप: troops, मातङ्गैःइव like elephants, चतुर्भिः four, सचिवै ministers:, वृतः surrounded, सः he, शोकलालसम् given to grief, महात्मानम् great soul, राघवम् Raghava, अभिगम्य reached, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणान् eyes full of tears, वानरांश्चापि Vanaras also, ददृशे witnessed

40017874.author: Translation
40017874.content: Accompanied by the four ministers surrounded by four ministers resembling leaders of elephants, who looked dark like collyrium, Vibheeshana came to highsouled Rama. He witnessed Vanaras whose eyes were filled with tears.

40017875.author: पदार्थः
40017875.content: महात्मानम् great soul, इक्ष्वाकुलनन्दनम् delight of Ikshvaku race, मोहम् deluded, आपन्नम् distressed, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अङ्कम् lap, आश्रितम् lying, राघवं च Raghava, ददर्श saw

40017875.author: Translation
40017875.content: He (Vibheeshana) saw the great soul, the delight of the Ikshvaku race deluded, distressed, and lying on the lap of Lakshmana.

40017876.author: पदार्थः
40017876.content: महात्मानम् great soul, इक्ष्वाकुलनन्दनम् delight of Ikshvaku race, मोहम् deluded, आपन्नम् distressed, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अङ्कम् lap, आश्रितम् lying, राघवं च Raghava, ददर्श saw

40017876.author: Translation
40017876.content: He (Vibheeshana) saw the great soul, the delight of the Ikshvaku race deluded, distressed, and lying on the lap of Lakshmana.

40017877.author: पदार्थः
40017877.content: सःविभीषणः that Vibheeshana, व्रीडितम् pained, शोकसन्तप्तम् immersed in grief, रामम् Rama, दृष्टवाseeing, अन्तःcondition, दुःखेन for grief, दीनात्मा depressed, एतत् all this, किम् for what, इति thus, अब्रवीत् spoke

40017877.author: Translation
40017877.content: Vibheeshana was pained to see Rama immersed in grief, depressed in spirit, and asked for What is all this grief for?

40017878.author: पदार्थः
40017878.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विभीषणमुखम् Vibheeshana's face, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, तान् those, वानरांश्च Vanaras also, दृष्टवा seeing, बाष्पपरिप्लुतः bathed in tears, मन्दार्थम् dull tone, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke

40017878.author: Translation
40017878.content: Lakshmana looking at Sugriva's face and also at the Vanaras, his eyes bathed in tears spoke in a dull tone.

40017879.author: पदार्थः
40017879.content: सौम्य noble, राघवः Raghava, हनुमद्वचनात् Hanuman's words, सीता Sita, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, हता killed, इति this, श्रुत्यैव on hearing, ततः then, मोहम् deluded, उपागतः became

40017879.author: Translation
40017879.content: "O Noble one! On hearing Hanuman that Sita is killed by Indrajith, Rama is deluded', said Lakshmana to Vibheeshana."

40017880.author: पदार्थः
40017880.content: विभीषणःVibheeshana, कथयन्तम् started telling, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, सन्निवार्य restraining, विसंज्ञम् unconscious, रामम् to Rama, पुष्कलार्थम् full of meaning, इदंवाक्यम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke

40017880.author: Translation
40017880.content: Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to Rama, who was unconscious, restraining Saumithri from speaking.

40017881.author: पदार्थः
40017881.content: मनुजेन्द्र Lord of humans, आर्थरूपेण thinking to be true, हनूमता from Hanuman, सु, यत् that which, उक्त spoken, तत् those, सागरस्य ocean's, शोषणम् इव drying up, अयुक्तम् not possible, अहम् I, मन्ये think

40017881.author: Translation
40017881.content: "I think that what has been spoken by Hanuman as truth (that Sita has been killed) is like drying up an ocean."

40017882.author: पदार्थः
40017882.content: महाबाहो mighty armed, सीतांप्रति with reference to Sita, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana's, अभिप्रायम् opinion, जानामि do not know, घातम् killing, न करिष्यति will never do

40017882.author: Translation
40017882.content: "O mighty armed Rama! with reference to Sita, you do not know Ravana's opinion. He will never kill Sita."
